scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build && cd .. && rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -r frontend/dist/. backend/public/ && rm -f backend/public/.htaccess
scripts.diag:logs: echo '--- Buscando logs ---'; find /var/www/vhosts -iname '*error_log*' 2>/dev/null | grep -i hotel || echo 'no encontrado con find'; echo '--- Procesos node activos ---'; ps aux | grep '[n]ode' || echo 'sin salida de ps'; echo '--- Puerto 3000 ---'; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3000 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 3000 || echo 'sin ss/netstat'
scripts.kill:debug: pkill -f 'backend/dist/index.js' && echo 'proceso de debug detenido' || echo 'no habia proceso corriendo'
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.clean: rm -rf backend/dist frontend/dist backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules node_modules
